## source_to_kb

### Extended policies claimed by task 1

**plan_ext_retro_authorization** (hub `retro_authorization_entry_e2a414a6`, computation `retro_visit_count_calculation_89f2a772`)
- Purpose sentence -> hub ("counted at a weekly visit frequency over the days of the gap, and names the earliest of those visits it asks to cover"). The source has "the plan's weekly visit frequency"; the hub drops "the plan's", and the frequency factor doc carries "the plan's own". Equivalent at the level of entailment, and the hub no longer hints at the factor.
- Baseline rule (gap from the day after the last drawn approval's end through today, both included; program weekly maximum × days / 7, rounded up) -> computation doc verbatim, plus the "last approval drawn on" definition (from compute). No modifier hinted.
- `gap_start` (all drawn -> day after the last drawing visit; never drawn -> day after the evaluation; otherwise day after end date; "all drawn" defined) -> `coverage_gap_start_e2ca29e0`, all tiers.
- `gap_end` (newer approval starting on/before today -> day before it; starting after today -> yesterday; otherwise through today) -> `coverage_gap_end_ae6e355b`, all tiers.
- `retro_window` (accepts and reaches further back -> from today − window; accepts none or no funded attendance since the gap began -> 0; otherwise all days) -> `retroactive_window_days_counted_e9bebf6c`, all tiers, per-program window table (= `retro_auth_window_days`), Appointment Series attendance named.
- `gap_frequency` (active series -> its visits/week; else booked series; else program weekly maximum) -> `gap_weekly_frequency_cb062b51`, all tiers + table (= `max_visits_per_week`).
- `already_asked_retroactively` (earlier retro requests -> visits asked; else retro approvals -> visits granted; else 0; result floored at 0) -> `prior_retro_requests_offset_b02ccb7b`, all tiers.
- Tool contract (agent; `visit_date` = earliest visit asked for, from the series history; `source_event_id` ""; `requested_visits`) -> hub; matches schema and implementation.
- Prerequisite: none.

**plan_ext_auth_extension** (hub `auth_extension_entry_fa200497`, computation `extension_visit_count_calculation_09d1c44a`)
- Purpose sentence -> hub verbatim.
- Baseline rule (period from today for as many days as the current authorization covers; program weekly maximum × days / 7, rounded up) -> computation doc verbatim + definition of the current authorization (plan record number/end date; span from the approval's first date). No modifier hinted.
- `period_start`, `period_end` (+ floor 0), `planned_frequency` (booked first, then active, then program maximum), `visits_not_yet_drawn`, `visits_still_to_draw` (ends on/before -> booked less attended/cancelled/no-show/released; runs past -> visits/week × days to end / 7, fraction dropped, today = day zero; otherwise 0) -> `extension_period_start_f2159ee7`, `extension_period_end_35204c2d`, `extension_planned_frequency_b707648a`, `undrawn_authorized_visits_6ec10195`, `visits_still_to_draw_27707c6f`. All tiers present with their conditions.
- Assembly (requested = planned − carried, carried = undrawn − still to draw, both floored at 0) -> `undrawn_authorized_visits_6ec10195`.
- Tool contract -> hub; matches.
- Prerequisite: none.

**plan_ext_noncovered_waiver** (hub `noncovered_waiver_entry_05241cd2`, computation `waiver_visit_count_and_date_d9570294`)
- Waiver definition -> hub ("covers every visit from its first date of service onward that runs past the limit").
- Overwrite `replaced_by` + visits counted + visits left + baseline rule ("The waiver's first date of service is today") -> computation doc. The source's "adjusted as set out below" is not rendered, which keeps the computation doc free of a modifier hint. Equivalent.
- `unbilled_appointments` (asked > granted -> asked − granted in their place; all granted -> none; no request -> every unbilled appointment; unbilled = attended on the active series in excess of treatment/progress/re-evaluation visits billed, floor 0) -> `unbilled_attended_appointments_861ac0e3`, all tiers.
- `telehealth_visits` (billed telehealth -> them; none billed and no retro request -> attended Telehealth 30-Minute Visit Series sessions; otherwise 0) -> `telehealth_visits_limit_count_ff39f4b1`, all tiers.
- `waiver_timing` (left > 0 and = still booked -> opening visit of next booked series; left > still booked -> no waiver yet, signed on the day of the first visit past the limit; otherwise today) -> `waiver_first_date_timing_1e5d62a7`, all tiers.
- `next_series_opening` (first booking rescheduled -> moved-to date; else first booking after start -> it; else start date) -> `next_series_opening_visit_2ce8651d`, all tiers.
- Form choice (`waiver_kind`: abn for Medicare, commercial_waiver for commercial) -> hub parameter table + `noncovered_visit_terms_by_program_5119e245` form column (= `non_covered_waiver_form`).
- Prerequisites (both form `state`), listed separately:
  1. <- plan_ext_retro_authorization: "The first date of service a waiver covers is fixed only after every visit attended without authorization within the payer's retroactive window carries a retroactive authorization request." Verbatim in `noncovered_waiver_entry_05241cd2` ("Conditions") and in no other document of any product. Connective "only after", state form intact. Resolution basis: `retro_authorization_entry_e2a414a6` describes the retroactive authorization request "for visits already attended ... without an authorization covering them"; records: attended 12/02 and 12/07 with no billed visit, inside the 14-day POS window, not covered by the 12/01 request (2 visits from 11/25). Same strength.
  2. <- plan_ext_auth_extension: "A waiver is not signed until the plan carries an extension request submitted since its current authorization was approved." Verbatim in the same hub only. Resolution basis: `auth_extension_entry_fa200497` describes the extension request "for more authorized visits"; records: current authorization CGA1084417 approved 12/04, the only extension request dated 11/12. Same strength (hard gate).
  - The hub's "Restated" paragraph keeps both in state form in the same document.
- Tool contract (owner user, hand-over, parameters) -> hub; matches.

## kb_to_source
- The sentence-by-sentence pass over the authorization-side documents and the waiver documents finds no normative claim without a source; "Newer means an approval other than the one last drawn on, received after it" and "the days from today to the end date count today as day zero" are restatements of compute (`LATEST` / `DAYS(NOW, cur_end)`).
- Additions: none. Rewrites changing meaning: none. Omissions: none.
- Check 1, cross-problem operational guidance: none. The waiver hub names only its own tool; the retro and extension hubs never mention a waiver, a limit or a waiter; no foreign tool name appears in any of the 7 corpora.
- Check 2, opening world state as policy fact: none. Every example is hypothetical, and none reproduces this task's dates or counts (CGA numbers, 12/02, 12/17, limit 20, etc.).

## bijection_verdict
**PASS.** First revision.

Policy-side notes (do not change this verdict):
1. The `plan_ext_noncovered_waiver` overwrite retires the base "visits used" formula outright, while its `replaced_by` defines the count only "ahead of a waiver"; the base clause "A visit whose date of service would make the visits used exceed the limit is not covered" then has no in-force definition of "visits used" outside a waiver. The KB renders the retired clause with a pointer to the waiver basis, exactly as the source has it.
2. Variant `entry_gate` fields (payer class, coverage active on the evaluation date, PCP referral, Medicare primary, in-network, physician order) have no prose home in `docs/plan/`. They are not read by any task of this difficulty and are not subjects of these policies, so they fall outside this audit's atoms. Recorded as a coverage observation only.

## dependency_form
- Hop marks from the frozen blind answer: waiver <- retroactive request and waiver <- extension request — both **state-derived**; none pre-solved.
- Both prerequisite sentences stand verbatim, in state form, only in the waiver hub; the "Restated" paragraph keeps the state form and names no action performer, tool or route.
- The depended-on hubs (`retro_authorization_entry_e2a414a6`, `auth_extension_entry_fa200497`) never disclose the waiver as a waiter, and both can be reached through the record words the sentences use (`auth_kind` retro / extension, "retroactive authorization request", "extension request").
- No aggregated chain, dependency table, roadmap, cross-problem step list, contrast example or FAQ spans problems. No task-mirroring title: "Advance Financial-Responsibility Waivers on the Insured Plan of Care", "Retroactive Authorization Requests for the Insured Plan of Care" and "Insured Plan of Care Authorization Extension Requests — Reference Card" name general subjects.
- Computation documents (`retro_visit_count_calculation`, `extension_visit_count_calculation`, `waiver_visit_count_and_date`) carry no modifier hint. Factor documents name no other factor or computation doc, state no customer's tier, and write no evidence rows as fact.
- Verdict: **PASS**.
